posts.author: OrangeJuice
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
I made a short and simple game (30 minutes to an hour) about the first session of my Pathfinder campaign I did with some friends a while ago. This was done on RPG Maker VX Ace. I can share a list of scripts and graphics ressources used if anybody is interested.
At first it was entierely for me and my friends but I have decided to share it here too, maybe someone will find it fun.
I hope you enjoy playing it as much as I did making it.
Synopsis :
Spoiler:
Gameplay Features
The Legend of JDR takes place in the Pathfinder universe as it is a real pen and paper session that happened between me and my friends that I transposed as a RPG Maker VX Ace game.
The game follows a group of 5 adventurers :
Ana, a sanguine human with the powers of the Valkyries coursing through her veins.
Faelen, a spirite half-elf, able to communicate with spirits and to use magic.
Flav, a fierce barbarian that would rather use her sword than her brain.
Kra, a tengu oracle with an admiration for the stars.
Sig, a wyvaran knight that swore an oath to the Dragon Knight order.
They found each other by chance somewhere in Darkmoon Vale and decided to travel together. As they take some rest in Darkmoon Vale's Inn, they meet a Halfling that will make them an offer. Will they accept ?
Gameplay features :
Spoiler:
Gameplay Features
The game used several scripts to enhance the base experience of a RPG Maker Game.
Free Movement : Characters are able to move freely and per pixel rather per square.
Sideview Battles : Battles are shown in a sideway fashion with pixel art sprites.
Overalled UI : the UI was enteriely remade to suit the pixel art aesthetic of the game.
Pathfinder Stats : The game uses the same system as Pathfinder for stats, so weapon dont increase Character's stats, however they deal damage when you use them according to their tier. (1d4, 1d8...)
Character Progression : Eeach member can go up to level 5
Longevity : This is a 30 minutes to an hour game.
